This is theft (盗窃). The amount is small (400 RMB + phone). The act is burglary? In Chinese criminal law, "入户盗窃" (burglary) is still theft; there is a specific offense "入户盗窃罪" (theft by breaking into a dwelling). The charge is 盗窃. However typical case of breaking into a house to steal is charged as theft (盗窃) and may also include "非法侵入住宅罪" if the theft is not proven? But here theft is proven. Usually the main charge is theft. In examples, they sometimes include both theft and illegal intrusion?
